prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Added `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore` and an Undo action on the message shown after deleting an episode on the Episodes page (English and Korean). Backend tests pass (29, 12 of them new) and the frontend type-checks; I did not run the page in a browser. A restored episode returns to the number it had when deleted, or goes last if the project now has fewer episodes than that. Restoring an episode that is not deleted returns it unchanged with 200. To carry Undo, the shared toast component gained an optional action button, and toasts with an action stay up 10 seconds instead of 5. The delete confirmation dialog still says "This action cannot be undone"; that is a shared Common string used elsewhere, so I left it.

+def duplicate_episode(
+    *,
+    session: Session = Depends(deps.get_session),
+    episode_id: UUID,
+    current_user_id: str = Depends(deps.get_current_user_id),
+) -> Any:
+    """
+    Duplicate an episode with its cuts. The copy is placed right after the
+    original (later episodes move down one place) and is independent of it.
+    Free of charge.
+    """
+    episode = session.get(Episode, episode_id)
+    if not episode or episode.deleted_at is not None:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    project = session.get(Project, episode.project_id)
+    if not project or project.deleted_at is not None:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    # Only members of the episode's workspace; to anyone else it does not exist.
+    try:
+        user_uuid = UUID(str(current_user_id))
+    except ValueError:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+    if not session.get(WorkspaceMember, (project.workspace_id, user_uuid)):
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    # The copy goes right after its original; later episodes move down one place.
+    siblings = _live_episodes(session, episode.project_id)
+    index = next(i for i, ep in enumerate(siblings) if ep.id == episode.id) + 1
+    new_order = index + 1
+
+    new_episode = Episode(
+        project_id=episode.project_id,
+        title=f"{episode.title} (Copy)",
+        story_summary=episode.story_summary,
+        episode_order=new_order,
+        # A copy is never mid-generation, even if the original is.
+        status="ready" if episode.status == "generating" else episode.status,
+        background_info=episode.background_info,
+        character_outfits=copy.deepcopy(episode.character_outfits),
+        character_reference_board_urls=copy.deepcopy(episode.character_reference_board_urls),
+    )
+    siblings.insert(index, new_episode)
+    _renumber(session, siblings)
+    session.add(new_episode)
+
+    cuts = session.exec(
+        select(StoryCut).where(StoryCut.episode_id == episode.id).order_by(StoryCut.cut_order)
+    ).all()
+    first_cut_image = None
+    for cut in cuts:
+        if cut.status == "generating":
+            cut_status = "completed" if cut.image_path else "idle"
+        else:
+            cut_status = cut.status
+        session.add(StoryCut(
+            episode_id=new_episode.id,
+            cut_order=cut.cut_order,
+            script=cut.script,
+            location=cut.location,
+            time_of_day=cut.time_of_day,
+            transition_ref=cut.transition_ref,
+            selected_layout=cut.selected_layout,
+            aspect_ratio=cut.aspect_ratio,
+            image_path=cut.image_path,
+            image_asset_id=cut.image_asset_id,
+            status=cut_status,
+            dialogues=copy.deepcopy(cut.dialogues),
+            appearing_characters=copy.deepcopy(cut.appearing_characters),
+            embedding=copy.deepcopy(cut.embedding),
+            refer_prev_cut=cut.refer_prev_cut,
+        ))
+        if first_cut_image is None and cut.image_path:
+            first_cut_image = _cut_image_url(cut.image_path)
+
+    session.commit()
+    session.refresh(new_episode)
+
+    return {
+        "id": new_episode.id,
+        "title": new_episode.title,
+        "episode_order": new_episode.episode_order,
+        "project_id": new_episode.project_id,
+        "story_summary": new_episode.story_summary or "",
+        "status": new_episode.status,
+        "created_at": new_episode.created_at,
+        "background_info": new_episode.background_info,
+        "character_outfits": new_episode.character_outfits,
+        "first_cut_image": first_cut_image,
+    }

+def restore_episode(
+    *,
+    session: Session = Depends(deps.get_session),
+    episode_id: UUID,
+    current_user_id: str = Depends(deps.get_current_user_id),
+) -> Any:
+    """
+    Restore a deleted episode, with its cuts, at the place it had. The episodes
+    from that place on move down one place.
+    """
+    episode = session.get(Episode, episode_id)
+    if not episode:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    project = session.get(Project, episode.project_id)
+    if not project or project.deleted_at is not None:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    # Only members of the episode's workspace; to anyone else it does not exist.
+    try:
+        user_uuid = UUID(str(current_user_id))
+    except ValueError:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+    if not session.get(WorkspaceMember, (project.workspace_id, user_uuid)):
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    siblings = _live_episodes(session, episode.project_id)
+    # Re-read under the project lock, so two restores at once do not both insert.
+    session.refresh(episode)
+    if episode.deleted_at is not None:
+        # A deleted episode keeps the number it had; its cuts were never removed.
+        position = min(max(episode.episode_order, 1), len(siblings) + 1)
+        episode.deleted_at = None
+        siblings.insert(position - 1, episode)
+        _renumber(session, siblings)
+        session.add(episode)
+        session.commit()
+        session.refresh(episode)
+    # Restoring an episode that is not deleted changes nothing.
+
+    first_cut = session.exec(
+        select(StoryCut)
+        .where(StoryCut.episode_id == episode.id)
+        .where(StoryCut.image_path != None)
+        .order_by(StoryCut.cut_order)
+        .limit(1)
+    ).first()
+
+    return {
+        "id": episode.id,
+        "title": episode.title,
+        "episode_order": episode.episode_order,
+        "project_id": episode.project_id,
+        "story_summary": episode.story_summary or "",
+        "status": episode.status,
+        "created_at": episode.created_at,
+        "background_info": episode.background_info,
+        "character_outfits": episode.character_outfits,
+        "first_cut_image": _cut_image_url(first_cut.image_path) if first_cut else None,
+    }

+                appearing_characters=[{"id": "c1", "name": "Mina"}],

+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.test_episode_duplicate import (
+    API, list_cuts, list_episodes, make_episode, make_project, orders, seed_cuts,
+)
+
+
+def delete(client, h, episode_id):
+    assert client.delete(f"{API}/episodes/{episode_id}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+
+
+def restore(client, h, episode_id):
+    return client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{episode_id}/restore", headers=h)
+
+
+def three_episodes(client, h):
+    project_id = make_project(client, h)
+    eps = [make_episode(client, h, project_id, title=t, order=i) for i, t in enumerate(("One", "Two", "Three"), 1)]
+    return project_id, eps
+
+
+def test_restore_puts_the_episode_back_at_its_place(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project_id, (_, two, _) = three_episodes(client, h)
+    delete(client, h, two["id"])
+    assert orders(client, h, project_id) == [("One", 1), ("Three", 2)]
+
+    r = restore(client, h, two["id"])
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    body = r.json()
+    assert body["id"] == two["id"]
+    assert body["title"] == "Two"
+    assert body["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert body["story_summary"] == two["story_summary"]
+
+    assert orders(client, h, project_id) == [("One", 1), ("Two", 2), ("Three", 3)]
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/episodes/{two['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 200
+
+
+def test_restore_first_and_last_episode(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project_id, (one, _, three) = three_episodes(client, h)
+
+    delete(client, h, one["id"])
+    assert restore(client, h, one["id"]).json()["episode_order"] == 1
+    assert orders(client, h, project_id) == [("One", 1), ("Two", 2), ("Three", 3)]
+
+    delete(client, h, three["id"])
+    assert restore(client, h, three["id"]).json()["episode_order"] == 3
+    assert orders(client, h, project_id) == [("One", 1), ("Two", 2), ("Three", 3)]
+
+
+def test_restore_brings_back_the_cuts(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project_id = make_project(client, h)
+    episode = make_episode(client, h, project_id)
+    seed_cuts(episode["id"])
+    before = list_cuts(client, h, episode["id"])
+    assert len(before) == 3
+
+    delete(client, h, episode["id"])
+    assert list_cuts(client, h, episode["id"]) == []
+
+    r = restore(client, h, episode["id"])
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json()["first_cut_image"].endswith(f"cuts/{episode['id']}/1.png")
+    assert list_cuts(client, h, episode["id"]) == before
+
+
+def test_restore_moves_newer_episodes_down(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project_id, (_, two, _) = three_episodes(client, h)
+    delete(client, h, two["id"])
+    make_episode(client, h, project_id, title="Four", order=3)
+    assert orders(client, h, project_id) == [("One", 1), ("Three", 2), ("Four", 3)]
+
+    assert restore(client, h, two["id"]).json()["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert orders(client, h, project_id) == [("One", 1), ("Two", 2), ("Three", 3), ("Four", 4)]
+
+
+def test_restore_when_the_place_no_longer_exists_goes_last(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project_id, (one, two, three) = three_episodes(client, h)
+    delete(client, h, three["id"])
+    delete(client, h, two["id"])
+    delete(client, h, one["id"])
+    assert orders(client, h, project_id) == []
+
+    # "Three" was number 3, but the project is empty now: it goes last, at 1.
+    assert restore(client, h, three["id"]).json()["episode_order"] == 1
+    assert restore(client, h, one["id"]).json()["episode_order"] == 1
+    assert restore(client, h, two["id"]).json()["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert orders(client, h, project_id) == [("One", 1), ("Two", 2), ("Three", 3)]
+
+
+def test_restoring_several_keeps_numbers_without_gaps_or_repeats(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project_id, (one, two, _) = three_episodes(client, h)
+    delete(client, h, one["id"])
+    delete(client, h, two["id"])  # was number 1 when deleted
+
+    restore(client, h, two["id"])
+    restore(client, h, one["id"])
+    numbers = [e["episode_order"] for e in list_episodes(client, h, project_id)]
+    assert numbers == [1, 2, 3]
+
+
+def test_restoring_an_episode_that_is_not_deleted_changes_nothing(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project_id, (_, two, _) = three_episodes(client, h)
+
+    r = restore(client, h, two["id"])
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json()["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert orders(client, h, project_id) == [("One", 1), ("Two", 2), ("Three", 3)]
+
+    delete(client, h, two["id"])
+    restore(client, h, two["id"])
+    restore(client, h, two["id"])
+    assert orders(client, h, project_id) == [("One", 1), ("Two", 2), ("Three", 3)]
+
+
+def test_restore_is_free(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project_id, (one, _, _) = three_episodes(client, h)
+    credits_before = client.get(f"{API}/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+    delete(client, h, one["id"])
+    assert restore(client, h, one["id"]).status_code == 200
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"] == credits_before
+
+
+def test_restore_is_hidden_from_other_workspaces(client):
+    owner = signup(client)
+    project_id, (one, two, _) = three_episodes(client, owner)
+    delete(client, owner, two["id"])
+    outsider = signup(client, email="<email>")
+
+    r = restore(client, outsider, two["id"])
+    assert r.status_code == 404
+    assert r.json()["code"] == "NOT_FOUND_EPISODE"
+    # Same for an episode that is not deleted, and for one that does not exist.
+    assert restore(client, outsider, one["id"]).json() == r.json()
+    missing = restore(client, outsider, str(uuid4()))
+    assert missing.status_code == 404
+    assert missing.json() == r.json()
+
+    assert orders(client, owner, project_id) == [("One", 1), ("Three", 2)]
+
+
+def test_restore_requires_a_token(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _, (one, _, _) = three_episodes(client, h)
+    delete(client, h, one["id"])
+    assert client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{one['id']}/restore").status_code == 401
+
+
+def test_restore_of_missing_episode_is_404(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    r = restore(client, h, str(uuid4()))
+    assert r.status_code == 404
+    assert r.json()["code"] == "NOT_FOUND_EPISODE"
+
+
+def test_restore_in_a_deleted_project_is_404(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project_id, (one, _, _) = three_episodes(client, h)
+    delete(client, h, one["id"])
+    assert client.delete(f"{API}/projects/{project_id}", headers=h).status_code == 200
+    assert restore(client, h, one["id"]).status_code == 404
